d: Haryana Steelers defeated Gujarat Giants by a 39-23 scoreline in match 46 of Pro Kabaddi League Season 11. Vinay and Shivam Patare ran rings around the defenders to score 12 raid points together. Rahul Sethpal on the other hand, stood his ground firmly as he accumulated 8 tackle points. Tune into PKL Season 11 every day from 7:30 PM, only on the Star Sports Network and Disney+ hotstar. Catch all the LIVE updates on prokabaddi.com or the Pro Kabaddi Official App.
